payload.title: Live-push server-originated object/stream writes to gateway subscribers
payload.description:
Writes made SERVER-SIDE via store.upsertObject / store.appendEvent (from background jobs and app command routes — e.g. a recurring job generating a WorkOrder, or POST /api/workorder/:id/complete) persist to storage + update projections/search, but are NOT broadcast to already-subscribed sync-gateway connections. Connected clients only pick them up via the slower cursor-based catch-up resync (or a full page reload); CLIENT-originated mutations, by contrast, push instantly through the gateway. For the realtime promise, server-originated writes should fan out to subscribers the same way.

REPRO: a @frick/core client subscribed to objects('WorkOrder'); call store.upsertObject(tenantId,'WorkOrder',id,value) from a job/route handler → the client does not receive a live update until it resyncs.

LIKELY FIX: route server-side store mutations through the same broadcast path the gateway uses for client mutations, or have the store emit a change event the SyncGateway subscribes to and fans out (object delta + stream-append frames). Tenant-scope the fan-out.

FOUND VIA aquarius-os: the recurring plan-heartbeat job and the generate-now / complete command routes all require a page refresh before the new WorkOrder / events appear in an open client. Closely related to FR-109 (projection delta-push) — same 'server → live client' fan-out gap, different surface (objects+streams vs projections).
